answer_result.name: answer_result
answer_result.value: ("answers"."review_status" = 'ungraded' and "answers"."earned_points" is null) or ("answers"."review_status" = 'pending' and "answers"."earned_points" is null) or ("answers"."review_status" = 'graded' and "answers"."earned_points" >= 0)

attempt_state.name: attempt_state
attempt_state.value: ("lesson_attempts"."status" = 'in_progress' and "lesson_attempts"."submitted_at" is null and "lesson_attempts"."earned_points" is null and "lesson_attempts"."max_points" is null) or ("lesson_attempts"."status" = 'submitted' and "lesson_attempts"."submitted_at" is not null and "lesson_attempts"."earned_points" >= 0 and "lesson_attempts"."max_points" > 0 and "lesson_attempts"."earned_points" <= "lesson_attempts"."max_points")

student_name_length.name: student_name_length
student_name_length.value: length("students"."display_name") between 1 and 120 and length("students"."lookup_name") between 1 and 120

student_group_length.name: student_group_length
student_group_length.value: "students"."group_label" is null or length("students"."group_label") between 1 and 80
